group: attachment:skill_listing (resident skill listing in the boot context)
flag_help_text: Disable all skills and commands (printed by `claude --help`, read 2026-10-26)
mechanism: treated arm sets CPP_CLAUDE_EXE (process env only) to a scratch wrapper that runs the same claude executable with --disable-slash-commands appended; no settings, env file, hook, rule or CLAUDE.md edit
instrument: python tools/floor_regression_gate.py --probe --cwd <repo> --json, results via CPP_FLOOR_PROBE_RESULTS to b3/probe-results.jsonl
design: 2 matched pairs, one per repo (PP repo, mcp-video-analyzer); each pair = baseline probe then treated probe, same cwd, same model, same fixed prompt 'Reply with the single word OK.'

frozen_saving_band_tokens.basis: W8 B3.md: skill_listing mean 6,693, per-session max 8,361 (ESTIMATE, chars/3.6); the band is on call-1 measured floor

pass_rule: a probe passes when it reaches its first call and its result is the word OK

verdict_rule.CERTIFIED: all 4 probes pass AND both pairs show (baseline floor - treated floor) inside the band
verdict_rule.REFUTED: all 4 probes pass AND at least one pair's delta is outside the band
verdict_rule.UNMEASURABLE: any probe fails to reach its first call, answers wrongly, or yields no measured floor

c3b: NONE: the agent listing (largest group, ~10.6K) has no flag in `claude --help` that removes it (--agents adds agents, --bare is a composite of hooks, CLAUDE.md, memory and skills). Not contracted.
known_noise: baseline call-1 floor varies by session (B3 range 84K-135K across repos); the pair design holds repo and prompt fixed, N=2 pairs bounds nothing statistically
side_effect_disclosed: --disable-slash-commands also removes commands; a treated pane could not invoke any skill
